# GREEN PLASTWOOD (SNG Eco India Pvt. Ltd.)

> Indian manufacturer of Wood Polymer Composite (WPC) building products — chaukhats (door frames), doors (solid, 3 layer, texture and digital print), WPC/PVC sheets & boards, window frames and WPC/PVC louvers. Founded 2012, head office in Ahmedabad, 3 manufacturing plants in Gujarat.

## Key facts
- Legal name: SNG Eco India Pvt. Ltd.; brand: GREEN PLASTWOOD; since 2012
- Corporate office: 1312, 1313, 1314, 13th Floor, Fortune Business Hub, Nr. Shell Petrol Pump, Science City Road, Sola, Ahmedabad – 380060, Gujarat, India
- Email: info@greenplastwood.com; phone: +91 90163 36119
- 3 manufacturing plants in Gujarat; production capacity 4,00,000 sq. mtr.
- 300+ projects, 50+ major stock points, 50+ corporate supply clients, exports to 4+ countries, 9+ certificates
- ISO 9001:2015 (QMS, scope: manufacturer and supplier of WPC and PVC products); Udyam MSME UDYAM-GJ-01-0302769; Importer-Exporter Code; IGBC membership (2024)
- Lab tests (Alekh Plastics Testing Centre, Nov 2022): water absorption 0.2%; UL-94 V-0; door frame density 0.90 g/cc, screw withdrawal 2236 N; door & board density 0.66 g/cc, compressive strength 65 MPa, flexural strength 23 MPa
- Customers include Adani, IFFCO, Indian Oil, Intas, KRIBHCO, MP Public Works Department, Skipper, Ramky Group, Podar Education Network
- WPC products are 100% water proof, termite & borer proof, fire retardant, formaldehyde & lead free and recyclable

- [WPC Door Frames](https://whitinkdesignstudio.github.io/Green-Plastwood/product-wpc-door-frames.html): Single Rebate Frame Size: 75 × 50 mm · 100 × 50 mm · 100 × 63 mm · 125 × 63 mm · 150 × 63 mm 60 × 30 mm · 65 × 40 mm · 90 × 45 mm · 90 × 63 mm; Double Rebate Frame Size: 120 × 50 mm · 125 × 63 mm · 150 × 63 mm; Window Frame: 70 × 30 mm · 120 × 50 mm; Profile Models: Mould & Groove · Mould & Plain · Square Model; Length: 7 ft, 8 ft, 9 ft, 10 ft Size can be customised on bulk orders.; Density: 750 kg/m³ to 1200 kg/m³; Colours: Light Ivory, Yellow Ivory, Pure White, Beach White, Teak Wood, Chocolate Brown, Coco Brown, Black NFC colour can be customised on bulk orders.; Warranty: 30 Years*

Other colours (White, Grey, Brown, Sephia, Teakwood): MOQ 300 doors.; Finishes: Plain with carving · Colour · Laminate · Texture · Digital print; Customisation: Thickness, width, length and density customised on bulk orders.

Other colours (White, Yellow, Brown): MOQ 300 doors.; Customisation: Thickness, width, length and density customised on bulk orders.
